conventions.note: Blocks import { store, config, routes, readEnv, payment, paymentContext, mail, siteUrl } from src/lib/store.ts and { resolveImage } from src/lib/images.ts. Both files ship in the template; keep those exports if you restructure. `store(Astro)` returns the per-request Store (memoised on Astro.locals) — call `await store(Astro).catalog.load()` for the catalogue snapshot.
conventions.runtime: Cloudflare Workers with a D1 binding named DB; see docs/store-platform.md.

blocks.name: product-card
blocks.description: Product tile with image, sale/sold-out badges and price; links through routes.product().

blocks.name: buy-button
blocks.description: Quantity + Buy Now form that POSTs a SKU to /api/checkout. Works without JavaScript.

blocks.name: product-gallery
blocks.description: Hero image with thumbnail switcher; degrades to the primary image without JavaScript

blocks.name: category-nav
blocks.description: Chip list of child categories for a category page

blocks.name: site-header
blocks.description: Sticky header with primary nav and a mobile menu listing top-level categories

blocks.name: site-footer
blocks.description: Footer with category links, contact and legal nav

blocks.name: cart
blocks.description: Browser cart (localStorage) with add-to-cart button, header badge and a cart page that hands off to /checkout/.

blocks.name: checkout
blocks.description: The store’s own checkout: address + shipping method page, order creation, adapter-neutral payment start, success and pending pages, processor webhook.

blocks.name: contact-form
blocks.description: Contact form with honeypot, posting to /api/contact which sends via SendGrid

blocks.name: order-lookup
blocks.description: Guest order status by email + order number, read from the store.

blocks.name: account
blocks.description: Buyer portal: sign-in by emailed magic link, order history with fulfilments and tracking, order detail, reorder, sign out. Sessions live in the store.

blocks.name: store-api
blocks.description: The Store API route (/api/skuio/v1/*) that SKU.io pulls orders from and pushes inventory, fulfilments and products to. Auth: STORE_API_KEY.

blocks.name: sitemap
blocks.description: sitemap.xml generated from the live catalogue.
